headline: Recommended paying one $300.00 pothole claim and denying five others, referring three to other parties.
summary: No one spoke during public input. The panel recommended paying Lisa Jones $300.00 for a pothole claim.
decisions: Recommended paying Lisa Jones $300.00 for a pothole claim, 3-0.
Recommended denying Juan Hernandez's $680.96 pothole claim because it was not filed within seven days, 3-0.
Recommended denying Bernard Donald Grossi, Jr.'s $140.00 tow claim, 3-0.
Recommended denying Norka Quezada's $1,350.00 pothole claim and referring it to the City of Central Falls, 3-0.
Recommended denying Megan Loiselle's $375.00 vehicle damage claim and referring it to JR Vinagro Construction Corp., 3-0.
Recommended denying Irma Velez-Parent's $94.00 property damage claim and referring it to Geneva Apartments LLC, 3-0.

PAWTUCKET CITY COUNCIL 
COMMITTEE ON CLAIMS AND PENDING SUITS 
September 10, 2026 
 
A meeting of the Committee on Claims and Pending Suits was held Thursday, September 10, 2026, 
at 6:23 p.m., in the Temporary City Council Office, Room 204, 2nd Floor, 100 Freight St. , 
Pawtucket, RI.   
 
Present – Councilor Rubio, Chair; Councilors Araujo and Moreno. 
 
Absent – 0. 
 
Councilor Rubio presided.  
 
Also present were Chris Crawley, Acting Director of Public Works; and Frank J. Milos, Jr., Esq., 
City Solicitor. 
 
The Committee conducted a public input period, at which there were no speakers.
